About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. 

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

As a member of our Financial Institutions business unit, you will serve as a trusted advisor to bank executives and boards of directors, helping clients navigate complex balance sheet, asset/liability management (ALM), interest rate risk, liquidity, and strategic planning decisions.

  • Lead client discussions that connect financial performance, risk exposures, and strategic objectives.

jobs.title: Compensation Manager
jobs.description_text:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

jobs.description_text:
About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced Digital Producer to join Tubi's Creative Studio, primarily supporting Growth Marketing and CRM, with additional Brand Marketing projects as needed.

This role will oversee the end-to-end production of high-volume creative campaigns and assets across static design, video, motion graphics, and copy. The ideal candidate is a proactive, highly organized problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, confidently manages competing priorities, and knows how to keep complex projects moving efficiently from brief through final delivery.

You'll work closely with internal creative teams, cross-functional stakeholders, and external agency partners to deliver high-quality work at scale while continuously identifying opportunities to improve processes, workflows, and production efficiency.

This is a hybrid role based out of our Los Angeles office. You must be willing to travel to our office 2-3 days/week. 

What You'll Do:

  • Own end-to-end creative production for Growth Marketing and CRM initiatives, with additional support for Marketing projects as needed.
  • Oversee high volumes of static and video assets, ensuring timely delivery, creative consistency, accuracy, and adherence to approved key art, trailers, templates, and brand standards.
  • Partner with Growth Marketing, CRM, and Creative

jobs.title: Director, Creator Growth
jobs.location_raw: Los Angeles, CA; New York, NY (Hybrid)
jobs.description_text:
About the Role:

Tubi is seeking a Director, Creator Growth to own the strategy and execution of our scaled creator acquisition program: this role builds the systems that bring creators to Tubi at scale.

You'll design acquisition processes, set the performance standards for the long-tail portfolio, and partner closely with our product team to remove friction from onboarding and content delivery. You'll also connect the scaled pipeline to the broader creator strategy, ensuring top-performing non-exclusive creators are identified and elevated for deeper partnership consideration.

The ideal candidate has built creator or partner programs at scale, blends strategic thinking with operational rigor, and leads with data. This is a high-impact role at the center of Tubi's creator growth strategy.

This role is hybrid and based in Los Angeles or New York, with regular in-office days required.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the strategy and execution for scaled creator acquisition, building the processes, systems, and partner relationships needed to grow the non-exclusive library to thousands of creators
  • Establish KPIs and measurement standards for the scaled program, monitoring creator and content performance across the long-tail portfolio and using data to continuously refine acquisition criteria and partner tiers
  • Partner closely with the product team to define and prioritize product requirement

jobs.title: Manager, Advertising Operations
jobs.description_text:
About the Role:

Tubi is seeking a Manager, Advertising Operations to lead a team of Ad Operations Specialists and set the standard for how we deliver, troubleshoot, and scale campaigns for Tubi's high-profile direct and programmatic clients. You will report into the VP of Advertising Operations & Campaign Management and partner closely with Ad Sales, Account Management, Media Strategy, and Engineering to make sure campaigns are set up correctly, deliver in full, and are measured and invoiced accurately.

Beyond owning day-to-day execution, you will coach and develop your team, build the processes and tooling that standardize programmatic deal setup and delivery monitoring, and act as the escalation point for complex technical issues across measurement, ad serving, programmatic, and data targeting. You should be comfortable in a space where industry standards are still being defined, and able to help Sales and clients meet their goals within the limits of existing ad serving technologies.

This is a hybrid role in New York City; employees are required four days in the office, subject to change.

What You'll Do:

Lead and develop the team

  • Coach, mentor, and manage a team of Ad Operations Specialists, including goal setting, performance reviews, and career development
  • Manage team resourcing and workload across campaigns, regions, and peak periods, including the weekend

jobs.title: Manager, Social Media
jobs.description_text:
About the Role:

Tubi is looking for a culturally fluent, highly creative Social Media Manager to help identify and bring to life the unexpected opportunities that keep Tubi at the center of culture and close to our fans.

This role will focus on cultural opportunity scouting, fandom and community marketing, and social-led activations. You'll be deeply tapped into what audiences are talking about, watching, sharing, and obsessing over, as well as, identifying the creators, communities, behaviors, and emerging moments where Tubi has a credible reason to participate.

Spotting the opportunity is only half the job. We're looking for someone who can turn cultural signals into ideas and then make them happen, whether that's an unexpected creator partnership, a community activation, a quick-turn stunt, an IRL fan moment, or something we haven't tried before.

You'll work closely with the broader Social team and partners across Brand, Content, PR, Creator, and other functions to help Tubi show up in ways that feel fan-first, culturally relevant, and unmistakably Tubi.

This is a hybrid role based out of our Los Angeles office. You must be willing to travel to our Los Angeles office two days/week.

Tubi is expanding its investment in emerging formats and next generation storytelling by partnering with the next generation of creators leveraging AI-assisted production. We believe technology is enabling a broader group of storytellers to be successful, and we want to be a great home and partner for this group to bring their ideas to Tubi’s global fan base, build new franchises, new story formats, and monetize their content. Our approach is creator-led and technology-enabled, with human creativity, compelling storytelling, and audience connection at the center. 

Tubi is looking for a Senior Director, Next-Gen Studio to lead the creative heart of this effort. jobs.title: Specialist, Media Planning
jobs.description_text:
About the Role:

The Specialist, Media Strategist is the executional engine of the ad campaign lifecycle, supporting the Revenue Operations team in pre-sales and post-sales activities, and executing sold campaigns flawlessly. Working closely with Account Managers, Ad Operations, and Sales – the Specialist supports pre-sales media planning processes and manages the operational mechanics of deal stewardship, campaign reporting, and creative management. This is a detail-driven, systems-heavy role for someone who thrives on process, accuracy, and turnaround speed, and who spots opportunities to automate repetitive work. This role is 4 days onsite. 

What You'll Do:

Pre-Sale Support

  • Forecasting inventory availability for media planning
  • Pulling research reports in support of go-to-market activities and client pitches

Campaign Setup

  • Order booking & validation, ensuring sold deals are processed accurately in our order management system.
  • Campaign updates & optimizations, making certain that changes are properly recorded in systems and communicated between teams.

Creative Management

  • Collect and aggregate campaign creatives, acting as the critical liaison between client service and operation teams.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Marketing Program Management
jobs.location_raw: San Francisco, CA; Los Angeles, CA (Hybrid)
jobs.description_text:
About the Role:

We are looking for a Senior Director, Program Management to serve as the operating backbone of the global Marketing organization. Reporting directly to the CMO, you will build and steward the operating model through which marketing programs and go-to-market efforts are planned, resourced, funded, sequenced, and delivered — across every marketing function and every international market we operate in.

This is not a role that manages a single portfolio. You will partner closely with growth, communications, marketing  (B2B+Brand) and regional teams, and be accountable for the connective tissue between them: the planning process, the marketing budget, the resourcing model, and the systems and tooling the org runs on. You will give the marketing leadership team a full overview “what are we shipping, what will it cost, who is doing it, and when will it land, as well as where a decision, dependency, or trade-off requires leadership attention.”

You will also be expected to lead with AI. We are not looking for someone to rebuild the program management function that existed five years ago — we want a leader who redesigns it around what AI now makes possible.

This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco or Los Angeles office. You must be willing to travel to our office two days/week.
